target_customer: Quick service restaurant chains and franchisees that run drive-thrus
problem: Drive-thru order taking is labor heavy and inconsistent; the product takes orders with conversational AI, upsells and writes to the point of sale.
business_model: B2B SaaS priced per store for AI order taking

founders.name: Will Edwards
founders.background_notes: First business hire and VP Revenue at Crew; corporate development at Intuit.

founders.name: Adam Proschek
founders.background_notes: Led product and engineering at Crew, which Square acquired in 2021.

competitors.name: Presto Automation
competitors.what: Voice AI for drive-thru order taking sold to chains
competitors.traction_then: Customers included Checkers and Carl's Jr. per 2023 coverage; vendor claimed 95% accuracy

competitors.name: SoundHound
competitors.traction_then: White Castle rollout to about 100 drive-thrus per 2023 coverage

competitors.name: Hi Auto
competitors.traction_then: Pilots with Checkers and Rally's reported

competitors.name: Wendy's FreshAI with Google Cloud
competitors.what: In-house chain voice assistant built on Google AI
competitors.traction_then: Pilot in Columbus, Ohio, unproven in 2023 coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: Accurate speech recognition over noisy drive-thru audio, menu understanding and POS integration are hard for a team of five; large language models in 2023 made conversational handling newly feasible.

defensibility.rationale: POS and audio integrations and chain pilots give some stickiness, but well-funded competitors and the chains themselves were building the same product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Chains and larger vendors ran their own programs. Deepgram, a voice AI infrastructure company, acquired OfOne in January 2026 for an undisclosed price.

market_need_then: Fast food chains faced labor costs and drive-thru speed pressure; the company cited about 200,000 US drive-thrus and a claimed saving of about $60,000 per store per year.

branding.domain_note: Uses of.one, a domain hack rather than a .com.

identity.visual_style: Stat callouts and short feature blurbs
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and benefit led with light personality, for example the line that the agent never forgets to ask

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found; the name is easy to misread (OfOne vs of.one vs Of One) and nothing shows it driving growth.

outcome_analysis: OfOne launched in the 2023 wave of LLM voice agents with founders who had scaled a frontline worker app at Crew. It reached pilots at national chains and SOC 2 compliance, but faced Presto, SoundHound and chain in-house efforts in a crowded market. It raised little publicly and was acquired by Deepgram in January 2026, alongside Deepgram's $130M Series C, to anchor a restaurant offering. The price is undisclosed.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators show about $500K pre-seed in April 2023 with YC, and one lists SignalFire and Correlation Ventures; no primary source, so no rounds recorded. Acquisition date conflicts (January 2026 vs a January 2025 listing); January 2026 matches Deepgram's Series C timing. Competitor coverage dated 2023 is at or just after the Winter 2023 batch. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (April 2023) rests on VCBacked and CB Insights (databases); Seedtable shows a conflicting 125K seed from YC in January 2023. No press confirms it.
